title: Use of Sedation and Local Anesthesia in Meatotomy: A Prospective Comparison Study
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to prospectively investigate the feasibility, pain control, and outcome of meatotomy performed under sedation and local anaesthesia compared with general anaesthesia with and without patient block
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Boys between 3 years and 18 years with meatal stenosis requiring meatotomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* ASA grade \> 2
